requirement: When battery SOC falls below 10% while the vehicle is in Drive, the system shall display a low-battery warning.
When a charging request is received and the connector is locked successfully, the system shall enable charging.
If battery voltage is below 300 V for at least 500 ms while the high-voltage system is active, the system shall set a low-voltage diagnostic fault.
If any prerequisite for high-voltage contactor enablement becomes invalid before contactor closure is confirmed, the system shall abort the contactor closing sequence.
